content_text: [1/3 @gregoryblotnick] for stock pitch templates/formatting, you could do a lot worse than going through these old Graham & Doddsville newsletters...some 30 linked here in each one, there's 3-4 MBA-level writeups that were usually entered in stock pitch competitions and/or won i.e. "1st Place in Pershing Square Challenge" (pulled two random screenshots from Spring 2018, below) on a 1-10 quality scale, there's prob a floor at 5-6, ceiling at 8...its less about any individual pitch, and more that reading 100s of them will help figure out "what matters." link to newsletters: https://business.columbia.edu/heilbrunn/resources/graham-and-doddsville-newsletter --- [2/3 @gregoryblotnick] also think reading lots of pitches = fastest way to upload a lot of the terminology in here...phrases stick better with live pitches/case studies attached to them https://x.com/gregoryblotnick/status/2088652018877423928?s=20 --- [3/3 @gregoryblotnick] related https://x.com/gregoryblotnick/status/2076456442282844198?s=20
